candidates.decision_relevance: Would show whether price, ETH/BTC, and cited warning observations changed before or after drawdowns and rebounds, reducing sequence and hindsight uncertainty.
candidates.evidence_reference: Weekly reviews repeatedly lack raw price paths, dated signal sequences, and freeze-time observations; recent daily analyses include only limited hourly history for ETH/BTC.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped BTC and ETH prices, ETH/BTC, and contemporaneous forecast/warning feature snapshots
candidates.missing_history_problem: Aggregate weekly returns and qualitative path descriptions cannot establish when deterioration became observable or whether it preceded subsequent moves.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would distinguish persistent broad participation changes from isolated proxy captures and allow comparison with price and relative leadership over time.
candidates.evidence_reference: Reviews cite missing W45/W46 breadth series; daily analyses report point-in-time top-100 proxies with changing membership and unconfirmed canonical breadth.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped breadth counts or advance ratios with constituent universe and membership recorded
candidates.missing_history_problem: Snapshots with changing membership cannot establish breadth persistence, sequence, or whether proxy readings reflected a broad move.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would establish whether reported flow divergence or outflows persisted across sessions and how settled flows aligned with price and breadth changes.
candidates.evidence_reference: Several analyses have only a latest settled session or stale weekly flow detail; others explicitly caution against extrapolating a single row.
candidates.metric_name: Dated settled BTC and ETH ETF flows in reported units
candidates.missing_history_problem: Sparse settled-flow observations do not show multi-session persistence or within-period alignment with rebounds and declines.
